name: AT&T Wireless (postpaid)
notes: Researched from public att.com support articles and the AutoPay discount guide only (no sign-in). Sign-in is a two-step AT&T sign-in with a user ID, email or wireless number; a one-time code goes to the AT&T wireless number on new browsers/devices and by text or email during setup (mfa email_or_sms). Online payment accepts cards, Apple Pay and PayWithMyBank; checking/savings accounts only when signed in, so guest payments are card-only. AutoPay is toggled On/Off and can be paused for a month; credit-card AutoPay drafts earlier than bank/debit (not expressible). AutoPay + paperless discount: $10/line with a bank account or AT&T Points Plus Card, $5/line with a debit card, none with other credit cards (rule not expressible). Payment arrangements are scheduled online by picking a date past the due date; agent-made arrangements carry a convenience fee. Wireless cancellation is by chat or 800.331.0500 (online only for some IL/MA/NY online orders), so cancel_service is unsupported online. Plan prices and the agent fee amount are not modelled.

guest_pay.note: Without signing in you can pay by card, Apple Pay or PayWithMyBank; checking or savings accounts need a signed-in account.

autopay_cancel.note: AutoPay cannot be turned off when your service or credit status requires it; turning it off removes AutoPay discounts.

payment_arrangement.note: Pick an available date after your due date on the payment calendar; if none appear you are not eligible.

cancel_service.note: Wireless service is cancelled by chat or by calling 800.331.0500; only some online orders in IL, MA and NY can cancel online. Bill periods are not prorated.

help.title: Ways to pay your AT&T wireless bill
paragraphs: You can pay online, in the myAT&T app, in person, by phone or by mail. Online, AT&T accepts Mastercard, Visa, American Express, Discover, JCB and Diners Club debit or credit cards, Apple Pay, and PayWithMyBank online banking.

Checking or savings accounts, AT&T promotional cards, BitPay and Mastercard Click to Pay are available only when you are signed in to your online account. Online payments usually post within minutes but can take up to 24 hours.

help.title: AutoPay and the AutoPay discount
paragraphs: Turn on AutoPay with a bank account, debit card or credit card: go to AutoPay, pick the account and toggle AutoPay On. Credit-card AutoPay drafts earlier; bank account or debit card drafts closer to the due date. It can take up to two bill periods to start, so keep paying until you see AutoPay is scheduled.

With paperless billing also on, wireless lines get $10 off per line each month when AutoPay uses a bank account (checking or savings) or the AT&T Points Plus Card from Citi, and $5 per line with a debit card. Other credit cards no longer earn a discount.
You can pause AutoPay for one month (not if there is no balance, the payment is within two days, or your status requires AutoPay), or toggle it Off. Turning AutoPay off removes the discount.
steps: Go to AutoPay and sign in.
Toggle AutoPay On (or Off) and follow the prompts.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Go to paperless billing, confirm the account, select Change, then choose Keep paperless billing or Cancel paperless billing and verify your email address.

Some services or credit statuses cannot switch to paper. If you stop paperless billing, paper bills start arriving by U.S. mail within two billing periods. AutoPay plus paperless billing earns a monthly discount on qualified plans.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: If you cannot pay by the due date, review the payment calendar and pick an available date to schedule your payment. If no dates after the due date are offered, you are not eligible.
Once made, the arrangement commits you to that method and date; payments start processing at 12 a.m. ET on that day and cannot be changed or cancelled. Pause AutoPay for the month if you use it.
Late fees apply after the due date, a convenience fee applies if you call or chat to make the arrangement, and a reconnection fee applies if you miss the date and service is suspended.

help.title: Cancel wireless service or remove a line
paragraphs: To remove a line or cancel service, chat with AT&T when available or call 800.331.0500. Only some wireless accounts in Illinois, Massachusetts and New York that were ordered online can cancel online.

Bill periods are not prorated, so cancelling mid-period still bills the whole period. Remaining installment balances for a device on the cancelled line are due right away. If you are moving your number, wait until the transfer finishes before cancelling.

extra.intent: Using AT&T's pages, find the monthly AutoPay discount per wireless line when AutoPay uses a debit card (with paperless billing). Do not change any settings.

solution.text: $5 per line per month with a debit card.

extra.intent: Find the phone number AT&T lists for cancelling wireless service or removing a line. Do not cancel anything.
